text: Upload PDFs, websites, YouTube videos, audio files, Google Docs, or Slides as sources, or discover new ones
quote: Easily upload PDFs, websites, YouTube videos, audio files, Google Docs, or Google Slides or discover new sources.

text: Chat with a notebook to get answers grounded in your sources with inline citations
quote: Chat with your notebook to get grounded information based on your sources with clear in-line citations for accuracy, transparency, and trust.

text: Transform sources into study guides, briefings, audio overviews, mind maps, and other formats
quote: Transform your sources into approachable formats such as study guides, briefings, audio overviews, mind maps, and more.

text: Each source supports up to 500,000 words or 200MB per uploaded file
quote: Each source can contain up to 500,000 words or up to 200MB for uploaded files.

text: Auto-generated summary of an entire source available in the Source Guide
quote: Find an auto-generated summary of the entire source in the Source Guide.

text: Hover over a citation to instantly see the full quoted source text
quote: You can hover over any citation to get the full quoted text right away.

text: Customize response style or persona (e.g. respond like a PhD student or role-play a host)
quote: Custom: Best for choosing a specific style ("Respond like a PhD student") or suggesting a role ("Pretend to be a role-playing game host.").

text: Make a notebook public and share it via link with any Google account holder
quote: You can make your notebook public and share a link with anyone with a Google account.

text: Paid subscribers who own public notebooks can view usage analytics
quote: Owners of public notebooks with paid subscriptions can view usage analytics in the analytics tab.

text: Listen to Audio Overviews on the go and download them for offline playback
quote: Listen to Audio Overviews on the go and download them for offline playback.

text: Share a website, PDF, or YouTube video directly into a notebook from your device
quote: Share content directly to Gemini Notebook when viewing a website, PDF, or YouTube video on your device.

text: Convert a saved note into a usable source within the notebook
quote: To convert a single note to a source: Open the note. Select Convert to source.

text: Export notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets
quote: You can export your notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets.

text: Generate mind maps that visually branch out main topics and related ideas from sources
quote: Mind Maps in Gemini Notebook visually summarize your uploaded sources, showing main topics and related ideas as a branching diagram.

text: Generate a Deep Dive audio overview where two AI hosts discuss and connect topics from sources
quote: Choose a format. Deep Dive (default) for an in-depth conversation. Two hosts unpack and connect topics from your sources in a lively conversation.

text: Generate Video Overviews that turn notebook sources into an engaging video
quote: Video Overviews transform the sources in your notebook into an engaging video.

text: Generate flashcards or quizzes as interactive study aids from source material
quote: Flashcards or Quizzes help you master your material by turning information from your sources into interactive study aids.

text: Generate infographics that visually summarize complex source information
quote: Infographics turn complex information from your sources into a single, engaging visual summary.

text: Generate a polished slide deck presentation from notebook sources
quote: Transform your sources into a polished presentation by generating a Slide Deck, perfect for sharing or reviewing key concepts.

text: Gemini Notebook is included as a core Google Workspace / Education service
quote: For Workspace and Workspace for Education users, Gemini Notebook is now a core service (like Gmail, Google Calendar, and Docs).
